items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: And the Tuxedo Brass Band, I think Papa Seltzer's band had that.

ctx.x: I was wondering about if you ever did hear any brass band up in the country like your father's I was too young. Even in late years, if you went up for a visit.

No, no. No. Never did hear. Never did go back. No. The only band when I got larger was I used to listen to, I think one of them was the Seltzer Brass Band. Yeah. And the Tuxedo Brass Band, I think Papa Seltzer's band had that. Yeah, he had that. But no Mardi Gras Day, well they'd make up a lot of bands, you know, they'd just pick up guys, because I know a lot of guys would just can of horn, fill out the band. Yeah, no Mardi Gras Day. And I played several Mardi Gras parades, and that was the biggest thing in the…
Was it, you didn't belong to any organized band then at all in the brass band regularly? No, no regular brass band.
